description.default: SiYuan's built-in import takes a few clicks: open the menu in the document tree and pick a folder or file. Drag the folder or file straight from your file manager onto the tree instead — same result, with the folder structure recreated and images and attachments uploaded. A result card appears afterwards, with undo, retry of failed items, and the import log.
description.zh-CN: 思源自带的导入要在文档树里点几下选文件。这里直接用资源管理器把文件或文件夹拖到文档树上，导入结果与官方相同，层级自动还原，图片与附件一并上传。导入结束后弹出结果卡片，可撤销、重试失败项、打开日志。
